Listen to this article Share COLLISION COURSE (2026) If you enjoy action, drama movies then this brand-new movie is one you should jump on, you know those kinds of movies where you have four different versions and scenarios of the same incident, you have to pay serious attention to understand the entirety of the movie, you have to watch to the entire end to know which one really happened. In this movie there was a four-man gang team, they decided to quickly walk-in early and rob the bank, but what started that day as a simple day, with a quick in and out strategy, turned out to be a total disaster, as the entire city began to look for them and there was nowhere to hide. The 106m Spanish, crime, drama, action movie was directed by Daniel Sanchez Arevalo, they featured actors like Lala Casta, Karra Elejaide, Luis Zahera, Tamar Novas, Alvaro Cervantes, Luis Homar etc.
If you enjoy movies about natural disasters, then you might want to jump on this brand-new movie, that talked about how hurricane destroyed their city. In this movie Wirpul lived his mother, his step mother and step brother in the same premises, but for some weird reasons, they never got along or lived in peace. Wirpul got a job as a captain and he needed an assistant, but couldn’t find any, so his mother begged his stepbrother Candi to accompany him, knowing fully well going to face a bad category 5 hurricane. Wirpul knew the weather would be bad but didn’t know how bad it will get, they would need to choose between saving their lives or the boat that was already insured, Wirpul wanted desperately to be a hero and this costed them their lives. The 96m Mexican, drama, social issues movie was directed by Jorge Michael, Gray, the featured actors like Benny Emmanuel, Kristian Ferrer, Monica Del Carmen, Andrew Leland Roger’s, Monica Jimenez, Gonzaga Vega Jr, Octavia’s Michel Grau etc.
If you are a sucker for romantic movies, then this will make your day, as these two complicated people, try to see what they can work out in terms of entering a brand-new relationship. Jane and Will met at a wedding and immediately got attracted to each other from the set go, but Will wanted to take things slowly and wanted them to talk, discuss and know each other better before jumping into anything, but Jane didn’t want to talk as she was sick and tired of talking. They both agreed to exchange true, deep, candid confessions about their pasts as this felt like a healing process for them, considering their terrible, complicated past and bad relationships choices their confessions were truly alarming and they both knew they needed to heal, before going into anything. Go watch the movie to see how it ended for both of them. The 98m romantic comedy film, drama, comedies, romance film based on books was directed by Peter Hutchins, they featured actors like Lucy Hale, Nat Woff, John Gallagher Jr. Genevieve Angelson, Britine Oldford, Ward Horton Alexander Hodge.
